user.title: Connect to Ledvance / Tuya
user.description: Enter your Ledvance (or compatible Tuya OEM) account credentials. Devices will be discovered automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Ledvance / Sylvania
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the updated password for your existing app account.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Tuya cloud — check your internet connection.
error.rate_limited: The Tuya cloud is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

legacy_local_key.title: Remove recorded Ledvance local keys
legacy_local_key.description: An older version could publish device keys through these sensors: {entity_ids}. If you use Recorder, run `recorder.purge_entities` for those exact entity IDs in Developer tools. Then remove the obsolete entities and reload the integration. Backups may also contain the recorded values.
